name: Shree Furniture
tagline: Steel and wood furniture in Hosur since 2009
address: 12 Bagalur Main Road, SIPCOT Phase 1, Hosur
about:
Shree Furniture has been making and selling steel and wood furniture in Hosur since 2009.
We supply homes, offices, hostels and factories across Hosur and Krishnagiri district. Custom sizes are made to order in our own workshop.
Walk in to see stock, or send us a WhatsApp message and we will share prices the same day.
